content: निर्धू €5 €9 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To shake or throw off, remove, dispel, expel, destroy; निर्धूतोऽधरशोणिमा <ls>Gīt. 12</ls>; ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः <ls>Bg. 5. 17</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 57</ls>. .²2 To spurn, treat with contempt, disregard; परुषाणि च संश्राव्य निर्धूतोऽस्मि बलीयसा <ls>Rām. 4. 8. 32</ls>. .²3 To abandon, forsake, throw away. .²4 To repudiate, disown, reject. .²5 To afflict, torment, distress. .²6 To move about, brandish.
